scripts.text:
[Thug]
*Sigh...*
What is life?
And what use
is money? ...Damn.
Damn this worthless life!
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
*叹气……*
人生是什么？
钱又有什么用？……该死。
这毫无价值的人生真让人火大！

scripts.text:
[Thug]
Hey, kid.
What the hell
are you lookin' at?
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
喂，小鬼。
你他妈在看什么？

scripts.text:
[Thug]
Then get the
hell out of my face!
Didn't you hear me?
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
那就给我滚远点！
没听见我说话吗？
快滚！

scripts.text:
[Thug]
Hmmm...
Maybe I'll swing by the ^0000FFRogue Guild^000000 in ^0000FFParos Lighthouse^000000...
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
嗯……
也许我该去^0000FF帕罗斯灯塔^000000的^0000FF流氓公会^000000逛逛……

scripts.text:
[Thug]
I needz my money,
and they best have it...
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
我需要我的钱，
他们最好把钱准备好……

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Eh? You...you...?!
Hey, haven't we met before?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
咦？你……你……？！
嘿，我们以前见过吗？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
..............
Awww, ^FF0000I am sorry^000000! I think I misunderstood you from someone I know.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
………………
啊啊，^FF0000对不起^000000！我想我把你误认成我认识的某个人了。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
I never misunderstand people...oh well, be safe anyway!
scripts.translation:
[马基]
我从来不会认错人……算了，总之保重！

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Yo, what are you doin'?!
You can't change your job if you got unused skill points, so use 'em all up. You bettah check yo-self before you wreck yo-self.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
哟，你在干什么？！
如果你还有未使用的技能点，就不能转职，所以先把它们都用完。在搞砸之前最好先检查一下自己。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
So what's a kid
like you doin' here?
Oh, I get it now...
The widdle boy wants
to be a ^800000Rogue^000000.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
像你这样的小鬼
来这里做什么？
哦，我明白了……
小弟弟想成为^800000流氓^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
So what's a kid
like you doin' here?
Oh, I see...
Lil' cutie wants 
to be a ^800000Rogue^000000.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
像你这样的小鬼
来这里做什么？
哦，我知道了……
小可爱想成为^800000流氓^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Eh, nice meetin' you, I guess. I'm Markie, and I do work for the Rogue Guild, a philanthro-- *ahem* a ^800000feelanthropist^000000 group, as you can see. So what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
呃，很高兴见到你，我想。我是马基，我在流氓公会工作，这是一个慈善——*咳咳*一个^800000“感觉”慈善^000000团体，如你所见。那么你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
...{0}?
Heh heh! Cool name.
If it was dorky, we'd
make you change it,
so you're in luck.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
……{0}？
嘿嘿！名字很酷。
如果名字很蠢，我们会
让你改掉，
所以你运气不错。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
So why you wanna join up with the Rogues? I guess you gave me your real name, so you'd be an honest Rogue. Not many of those around, heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[马基]
那么你为什么想加入流氓公会？我想你给了我真名，所以你会是个诚实的流氓。这样的人可不多，嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Rule number 1 for Rogues...
Never give out your real identity to most people, most of the time. It's just a little backup measure we like to use.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
流氓的第一条规则……
大多数时候，不要向大多数人透露你的真实身份。这只是我们喜欢使用的一点备用措施。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Right. I'm officially accepting your application, so now you gotta take a test. Don't sweat it, this first one is real simple.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
好的。我正式接受你的申请，现在你必须参加测试。别紧张，这第一个测试非常简单。

[马基]
好吧……
让我们开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
You again?
Okay, you probably screwed up last time 'cuz you were way too nervous. So just chill and pass
this test, okay?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
又是你？
好吧，你上次可能因为太紧张而搞砸了。所以放轻松，通过
这次测试，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Go talk to Smith. His test might be pretty hard. He's one of the guys who makes sure that people pay up their debts to us. So yeah, he might be a bit of a hard case.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
去和史密斯谈谈。他的测试可能相当难。他是确保人们向我们偿还债务的人之一。所以是的，他可能有点难对付。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Yeah...
That guy can be pretty anal, but we need a guy like him in our guild. Anyway, be careful. Lots of luck to you, pal.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
是啊……
那家伙可能有点挑剔，但我们的公会需要像他这样的人。总之，小心点。祝你好运，伙计。

[马基]
嘿哟……
尽力而为。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Heh heh...
Fresh meat. This'll be
a cinch to--Wait! Er, I wasn't talkin' about you! I meant the other fresh meat~
scripts.translation:
[马基]
嘿嘿……
新鲜血液。这将是
小菜一碟——等等！呃，我不是在说你！我说的是其他的新鲜血液~

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Oh hey, it's you!
You did a good job, guy.
Now, lemme change your
job to Rogue. You earned it!
scripts.translation:
[马基]
哦嘿，是你！
你做得很好，伙计。
现在，让我把你的
职业改为流氓。这是你应得的！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Oh! It's you!
You were actually able to put up with that guy? Good stuff! Must've had a rough time collect all those items, eh?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
哦！是你！
你真的能忍受那家伙？干得好！收集那些物品一定很辛苦吧，嗯？

[马基]
恭喜~！
你看起来
太帅了！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Hey hey~
Congrats!
You've been
doin' a great job~
scripts.translation:
[马基]
嘿嘿~
恭喜！
你一直
做得很好~

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Now...
It's time
for me to make
a speech~ *Ahem*
scripts.translation:
[马基]
现在……
是时候
让我发表
演讲了~ *咳咳*

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Enjoy your freedom as a Rogue. Just remember that you gotta be free and responsible at the same time. So treat other guys the way you wanna be treated, kay? Alright, seeya round.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
享受你作为流氓的自由。只要记住，你必须同时保持自由和负责任。所以像你希望被对待的那样去对待其他人，好吗？好了，回见。

scripts.text: Hold on, I need to get ready!
scripts.translation: 等一下，我需要准备一下！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Get ready...?
Fine, fine.
Take your sweet
time, why don't you?
But hurry up and
come back, got it?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
准备……？
好吧，好吧。
慢慢来，
怎么样？
但快点回来，
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Listen carefully, and
pick the right answer.
Capish? Now, lemme
read these questions...
scripts.translation:
[马基]
仔细听，
并选择正确的答案。
懂了吗？现在，让我
读这些问题……

scripts.text:
[Markie]
1. Choose the skill necessary for learning ^880000Stalk^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
1. 选择学习^880000潜遁^000000所需的技能。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
2. In comparison to the Merchant's Level 10 ^880000Discount^000000 skill, how much more of a discount, in terms of percent, can a Rogue get with Level 10 ^880000Haggle^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
2. 与商人的10级^880000低价买进^000000技能相比，流氓的10级^880000强制减价^000000技能在百分比上能多获得多少折扣？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
3. What is the correct description for the skill, ^880000Mug^000000?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
3. 对技能^880000偷钱^000000的正确描述是什么？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
4. How many Rogues does it require to activate the skill, ^880000Slyness^000000?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
4. 激活技能^880000流氓天国^000000需要多少名流氓？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
5. Choose the skill that you can learn at Level 5 ^880000Divest Helm^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
5. 选择在5级^880000卸除头盔^000000时可以学习的技能。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
6. Choose the skill which allows its user to move while hiding.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
6. 选择允许使用者在隐匿状态下移动的技能。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
7. Choose the card that increases the accuracy rate of its owner.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
7. 选择增加所有者命中率的卡片。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
8. Choose the monster that receives more damage when it's attacked by a weapon with the Vadon card (20 % more damage on Fire property).
scripts.translation:
[马基]
8. 选择被镶嵌螃蟹卡片（火属性伤害增加20%）的武器攻击时受到更多伤害的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
9. How much SP does the skill ^880000Double Attack^000000 require when used with a Dagger?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
9. 使用短剑时，技能^880000二刀连击^000000需要多少SP？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
10. Choose the most efficient dagger to use in the Byalan Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
10. 选择在拜兰地下洞穴中最有效的短剑。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
1. Which monster drops a slotted Gladius?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
1. 哪种魔物掉落带插槽的刺刀？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
2. Which monster drops a slotted Main-Gauche?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
2. 哪种魔物掉落带插槽的主要左手剑？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
3. Choose the class that is able to create unique potions.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
3. 选择能够制作独特药水的职业。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
4. Choose the weapon that Rogues aren't allowed to use.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
4. 选择流氓不允许使用的武器。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
5. Choose the property that the monster Hode possesses.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
5. 选择魔物蚯蚓拥有的属性。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
6. Choose the monster that is unable to be tamed for as a Cute Pet.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
6. 选择无法驯服为可爱宠物的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
7. Choose the monster that receives more damage from a Dagger with the Fire property.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
7. 选择受到火属性短剑攻击时受到更多伤害的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
8. Choose the town that doesn't have any guild castles.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
8. 选择没有任何公会城堡的城镇。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
9. Choose the plant that drops Blue Herbs.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
9. 选择掉落蓝色药草的植物。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
10. Choose the monster that does not have the Undead property.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
10. 选择不具有不死属性的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
1. By what percentage is the flee rate increased when a Thief masters the ^880000Improve Dodge^000000?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
1. 当盗贼精通^880000残影^000000时，回避率增加百分之多少？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
2. Choose the monster that detects a characters using the Hiding or Cloaking skill.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
2. 选择能侦测使用隐匿或伪装技能的角色的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
3. Choose the location where Thieves can change their jobs to Rogues.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
3. 选择盗贼可以转职为流氓的地点。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
4. In which town can Novices change their jobs to Thieves?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
4. 初心者在哪个城镇可以转职为盗贼？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
5. Choose the card that does not affect the DEX stat.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
5. 选择不影响DEX属性的卡片。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
6. So what's cool about being a Rogue?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
6. 那么成为流氓有什么酷的？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
7. When is it possible to change jobs from Thief to Rogue?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
7. 什么时候可以从盗贼转职为流氓？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
8. You want to dye your hair blue. What town do you go to, and in which direction, with 12 o' clock being North.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
8. 你想把头发染成蓝色。你去哪个城镇，朝哪个方向，12点钟方向是北。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
9. Choose the mushroom that is required on the Thief job change quest.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
9. 选择盗贼转职任务所需的蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
10. Choose the card that least benefits the Rogue class.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
10. 选择对流氓职业受益最少的卡片。

[马基]
*呼~*
终于。
我们完成了。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Let's see.
You got...
{0} points.
Good. You passed.
We don't gotta
do that again.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
让我看看。
你得了……
{0}分。
很好。你通过了。
我们不需要
再那样做了。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Let's see.
You got...
{0} points.
Aw crud... You failed!
scripts.translation:
[马基]
让我看看。
你得了……
{0}分。
哎呀糟了……你失败了！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
But don't get too comfortable just yet, you got more o' these tests. Your next one will be from Smith.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
但别太舒服，你还有更多的测试。你的下一个测试来自史密斯。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
So...
Go find Smith and finish up this test, yeah? Be careful though, Smith's a pretty anal guy.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
所以……
去找史密斯完成这个测试，好吗？不过要小心，史密斯是个相当挑剔的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Man, you shoulda learned more when you had the chance. Thanks for wasting my time.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
伙计，你应该在有时间的时候多学点。谢谢你浪费我的时间。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
*Sigh...* Lemme give you some tips, yeah? I'm supposed to tell you about some kind of ^990000iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000 to help you learn what you need to know.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
*叹气……* 让我给你一些提示，好吗？我应该告诉你关于^990000iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000的一些事情，以帮助你学习你需要知道的东西。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Of course, I don't know what the heck it means, but if you understand it, it'll probably help you out a lot.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
当然，我不知道那到底是什么意思，但如果你理解了，它可能会对你有很大帮助。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Whoa, slow down newbie. We only accept people who are at least Thief Job Level 40. I ain't risking myself by letting you in before you're ready. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
哇，慢点，新手。我们只接受至少盗贼职业等级40级的人。在你准备好之前，我不会冒险让你进来。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Huh...?
What's an Assassin doin' here? Uh, you haven't been assigned to kill someone in the Rogue Guild, are you?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
哈……？
刺客来这里做什么？呃，你没有被指派来杀死流氓公会的某人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
In any case, don't mess with us! You can't catch me... I'm a smooth criminal!
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
无论如何，别惹我们！你抓不到我……我是个优雅的罪犯！

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Don't get it, huh? It's something I always used to say to Huey. If you're in the Assassin Guild, you oughta have met him...
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
不懂吗？这是我以前常对休伊说的话。如果你在刺客公会，你应该见过他……

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Hey hey~
Long time no see.
Eh, right now we don't
any requests from the
guild for you, so just
check back again later.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
嘿嘿~
好久不见。
呃，现在我们没有
来自公会的任何
请求给你，所以稍后
再来看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Hey you...
Get your ugly
ass out of here
before I redecorate
that face of yours!
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
嘿你……
在我重新装饰
你的脸之前，
把你丑陋的屁股
移出这里！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Welcome to
the Rogue guild.
From here on, I will
verify your qualification.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
欢迎来到
流氓公会。
从现在开始，我将
验证你的资格。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Before we get started,
I want you to know
about something...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
在我们开始之前，
我想让你知道
一些事情……

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
All new Rogues are required to pay an application fee, so I hope you take care of that first.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
所有新流氓都需要支付申请费，所以我希望你先处理好这件事。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What you have to understand is that the Rogue Guild does a lot of business, ^666666sometimes illegally^000000, that needs financial backup.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
你需要理解的是，流氓公会做很多生意，^666666有时是非法的^000000，需要资金支持。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I will let you know...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我会让你知道……

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I will let you know......
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我会让你知道……

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I will let you know........
By the way.....
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我会让你知道……
顺便说一句……

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Oh man...
This is...
Damn...
Annoying!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
哦天……
这是……
该死……
真烦人！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Today, I'm in a pissed off mood, ya' know why?! I haven't collected any bills! God! Idiot Thieves coming at me all the time, wanting to become Rogues!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
今天，我心情很糟，你知道为什么吗？！我还没有收到任何账单！上帝！愚蠢的盗贼总是来找我，想成为流氓！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Jesus! Now I understand why our leader told us that working as customer support sucks.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
耶稣！现在我明白为什么我们的首领告诉我们做客户服务很糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
That god damn guild master assigned me to this shitty job. I'm better than this F$@king job!
That bastard should go to F$@king hell, I'm gonna kick that mother F$@kers ass! F#%k F#%k F#%k !!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
那个该死的公会会长把这份烂工作分配给我。我比这该死的工作强多了！
那个混蛋应该下地狱，我要踢那个混蛋的屁股！F#%k F#%k F#%k !!!

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
That dipshit who just tried to change his job, the one before you...
You know what the f#@k he talked to me about?!?
F#$@%#$*#$%@#$!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
刚才那个想转职的蠢货，就在你之前……
你知道他跟我说了什么吗？！
F#$@%#$*#$%@#$!!

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the--?! What's with this chat filter?! Stop #*!@$ing me! you stupid F#$%*! Let me talk!!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么——？！这个聊天过滤器是怎么回事？！停止 #*!@$ing 我！你这个愚蠢的 F#$%*！让我说话！！！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the f#@k you looking at...? {0}? That's your name!?
 
[{1}]
Umm...
Sir...?
I didn't mean to make you upset. I just came here to so I could become a Rogue.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
你他妈在看什么……？{0}？那是你的名字！？
 
[{1}]
嗯……
先生……？
我不是故意让你生气的。我只是来这里为了成为流氓。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Holy shit on a stick, what the f#$k was I just f!#king talking about, you moron!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
天哪，我刚才他妈的在说什么，你这个白痴！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Just leave me alone! Just leave alone! Just leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
别管我！别管我！别管我！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Do whatever you want, okay? Just do whatever the F$!!K you want...!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
随你便，好吗？就做你想做的 F$!!K ……！！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Crysalis^000000!
^FF00005 Empty Bottle^000000!
^FF00005 Iron Ore^000000!
^FF00005 Stone Heart^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Red Herb^000000!
^FF00005 Animal Skin^000000!!
^FF00005 Yellow Gemstone^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Tooth of Bat^000000!
^FF00005 Scorpion Tail^000000!!
^FF00005 Yoyo Tail^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Feather of Birds^000000!
^FF00005 Talon^000000!!
^FF00005 Spawn^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
Don't even think about coming back until you've got all those or I'll kill you where you stand.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
在你拿到所有这些之前，甚至不要想回来，否则我会当场杀了你。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the F$@k? Did you just say I'm annoying you? Shut up, you ungrateful prick!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么 F$@k？你刚才说我烦你？闭嘴，你这个不知好歹的混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I just added ^FF000010 Raccoon Leaf^000000 to the list. You better get it!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我刚刚在列表中添加了^FF000010个变身叶子^000000。你最好拿到它！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
F%$#*&#@$%#@$@#$%@$%&*k! Haven't you ever thought about how hard it would be to be an NPC!?!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
F%$#*&#@$%#@$@#$%@$%&*k！你有没有想过做一个NPC有多难？！？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Three thousand, two hundred seventy two. Three thousand, two hundred seventy three. Three thousand, two hundred seventy four...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
三千二百七十二。三千二百七十三。三千二百七十四……

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Uhh...
Headache...
This is too much
zeny to count.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
呃……
头痛……
这么多
泽尼要数。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Uh...?
What are you doing here? If you're going to talk about the job change, you need to speak to the other guy first.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
呃……？
你在这里做什么？如果你要谈论转职，你需要先和另一个人谈谈。

[史密斯先生]
……该死！
我数不清了！

[史密斯先生]
嗯……让我看看……

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Wow, you've brought each and every single thing I asked you to. Good work... I salute you.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
哇，你把我要求的每一样东西都带来了。干得好……我向你致敬。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Since you showed such great effort, I'm going to write a recommendation letter for you. I usually don't do that, you know.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
既然你表现出如此大的努力，我将为你写一封推荐信。我通常不这样做，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
But I'm sure you'll be a great asset to the Rogue Guild. Hmm, I don't have a blank piece of paper right now, so take this instead...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
但我相信你会成为流氓公会的宝贵资产。嗯，我现在没有空白纸张，所以拿这个代替……

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
*Sigh...*
I know, I know. I'm supposed to control myself in the work place. Getting enraged is a bad habit...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
*叹气……*
我知道，我知道。我应该在工作中控制自己。发怒是个坏习惯……

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
*Mumble mumble...*
How was I... *Mumble...*
How did... I remember...
*Sigh* It was all because of my bad temper!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
*喃喃自语……*
我怎么……*喃喃……*
我怎么……我记得……
*叹气* 这都是因为我脾气不好！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt might be a better
idea to come back later.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF稍后再来可能是个更好的主意。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Listen this time!
Application fee:
^FF000010000 zeny^000000,
^FF00005 Crysalis^000000!
^FF00005 Empty Bottle^000000!
^FF00005 Iron Ore^000000!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Stone Heart^000000!!
^FF00005 Red Herb^000000!
^FF00005 Animal Skin^000000!!
^FF00005 Yellow Gemstone^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Tooth of Bat^000000!
^FF00005 Scorpion Tail^000000!!
^FF00005 Yoyo Tail^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Feather of Birds^000000!
^FF00005 Talon^000000!!
^FF00005 Spawn^000000!!
^FF000010 Raccoon Leaf^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
Don't even think
of coming back
without them!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
没有它们甚至不要想
回来！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Let me see...
Who would should
I send you to...?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
让我看看……
我应该把你派给谁……？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Right! I know
just the guy~!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
对了！我知道
合适的人选~！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go visit Aragham Junior who lives South of the Sandarman Fortress. That area is located one field east from here.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去拜访住在桑德曼堡垒南边的小阿拉甘。那个区域位于从这里向东一个地图场。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
He's a pretty nice guy, you know. He works hard and is really good at bill collecting.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他是个相当不错的人，你知道的。他工作努力，非常擅长收债。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Before he joined the Rogue Guild, people have been trying to kill him for something his father did in the past. So, he became a runaway.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
在他加入流氓公会之前，人们一直试图因为他父亲过去做的事情而杀死他。所以，他成了逃亡者。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Well anyway, that's why he's been with us. We've been helping him hide from his enemies.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯，不管怎样，这就是他和我们在一起的原因。我们一直在帮助他躲避敌人。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah, you might want to remember the password if you want to meet him. He doesn't let anybody in his house without the password.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
啊，如果你想见他，你可能想记住密码。没有密码，他不让任何人进他的房子。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FFAragham never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
密码是^0000FF阿拉甘从不囤积升级物品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Well, I will wish you luck. His place isn't that far from here, so come back as soon as possible. Being swift... That is the spirit of the Rogue.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
好吧，我祝你好运。他的地方离这里不远，所以尽快回来。敏捷……那是流氓的精神。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmm...
This guy might be
good for you, but...
He's a little dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯……
这家伙可能适合你，但是……
他有点危险。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I want you to meet Antonio Junior, son of Antonio the first. For some reason people have been trying to kill him because of something his father did in the past.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我想让你见见安东尼奥的儿子小安东尼奥。出于某种原因，人们一直试图因为他父亲过去做的事情而杀死他。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
He was brought up in Payon, but he's staying in an empty house near the Kokomo beach at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他在斐扬长大，但目前住在克克魔海边附近的一所空房子里。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I've heard lately that he's been complaining a lot about the noise outside of his house, and he fears an assassination attempt. Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我最近听说他一直在抱怨房子外面的噪音，并且担心暗杀企图。总之……

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
He's kind of tense, so he throws a dagger at anyone who approaches his house. He has a violent personality.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他有点紧张，所以他会向接近他房子的任何人扔短剑。他性格暴力。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
However, he does have magnificent business skills. And he also loves gambling. Once you get to know him, he'll take care of your Rogue training really well.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
然而，他确实有出色的商业技能。他也喜欢赌博。一旦你了解他，他会很好地照顾你的流氓训练。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah, you might want to remember the password to meet him in person. The password is ^0000FFAntonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
啊，如果你想亲自见他，你可能想记住密码。密码是^0000FF安东尼奥不喜欢破坏升级物品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmm...
This guy might be
good for you, but...
He's a little dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯……
这家伙可能适合你，但是……
他有点危险。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
His name is
Hollgrehenn Junior,
a genius at manipulation.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他的名字是
小霍尔格雷恩，
操纵天才。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
However, because of something his father did long ago, people have been trying to kill him. Because of this, he is very high strung and will throw daggers at people he doesn't trust.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
然而，因为他父亲很久以前做的事情，人们一直试图杀死他。因此，他非常紧张，会向他信任的人扔短剑。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Our leader has been able to get him to join our guild, and his brilliant mind has been an asset to us. Once you get to know him, he'll take care of your Rogue training really well.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我们的首领已经让他加入了我们的公会，他聪明的头脑一直是我们的资产。一旦你了解他，他会很好地照顾你的流氓训练。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah, you might want to remember the password to meet him in person. The password is ^0000FFMy father never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
啊，如果你想亲自见他，你可能想记住密码。密码是^0000FF我父亲从不囤积升级物品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Alright... Now that I've calmed down, I can inform you of your next destination. *Whew*
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
好吧……现在我冷静下来了，我可以通知你下一个目的地。*呼*

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go and find Hermanthorn Junior, who is living near the ^0000FFthe checkpoint of Paros Lighthouse^000000, which is at the border between Morocc and Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去寻找赫曼索恩，他住在^0000FF帕罗斯灯塔的检查站^000000附近，那里位于梦罗克和克魔岛的边界。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah...almost forgot, keep in mind not to mention anything about upgrading items. This is very important.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
啊……差点忘了，切记不要提及任何关于升级物品的事情。这非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What...?
Did you just
say that you
forgot where to go?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么……？
你刚才
说你不记得
去哪里了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Head one field East and enter the building that is South of the Sandarman Fortress to meet Aragham Junior.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
向东走一个地图场，进入桑德曼堡垒南边的建筑物，去见小阿拉甘。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FFAragham never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
密码是^0000FF阿拉甘从不囤积升级物品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What...?
Did you just
say that you
forgot where to go?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么……？
你刚才
说你不记得
去哪里了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go to the building
at Kokomo Beach,
which is on the way
to Comodo, to meet
Antonio Junior.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去克克魔海边的建筑物，
那是去克魔岛的路上，
去见小安东尼奥。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FF'Antonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
密码是^0000FF‘安东尼奥不喜欢破坏升级物品’^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What...?
Did you just
say that you
forgot where to go?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么……？
你刚才
说你不记得
去哪里了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go to the field South of Sandarman Fortress, which is on the way to Morocc from here, to meet Hollgrehenn Junior.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去桑德曼堡垒南边的地图场，那是从这里去梦罗克的路上，去见小霍尔格雷恩。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FFMy father never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
密码是^0000FF我父亲从不囤积升级物品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmmm...?
Don't you have
to go somewhere
else to complete
your Rogue training?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯……？
你不是必须去
其他地方完成
你的流氓训练吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
First, the
application fee:
^FF000010,000 zeny^000000.

[Mr. Smith]
Hmm...?
What was that?
Did you just say that
you're willing to donate
more for the guild?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯……？
那是什么？
你刚才说
你愿意为公会
捐赠更多吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
That sounds sweet,
I appreciate that.
But come back when
you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
听起来不错，
我很感激。
但当你准备好时
再回来。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Okay, we've got the application fee, ^FF000010,000 zeny^000000, {0} {1}, {2} {3}, {4} {5} and {6} {7}...

[Mr. Smith]
Great, great...
I think you
brought everything.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
太好了，太好了……
我想你
带来了一切。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Alright, wait just a moment while
I prepare these things. Let's see... Your next test is...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
好吧，等我准备这些东西的时候稍等片刻。让我看看……你的下一个测试是……

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the f$@k!? You didn't bring all the required items?! Are you telling me that you need to check the requirements again!?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么 f$@k！？你没有带来所有需要的物品？！你是告诉我你需要再次检查要求吗？！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Now listen...!
Bring ^FF000010,000 zeny^000000,
and the following items...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
现在听着……！
带来^FF000010,000泽尼^000000，
以及以下物品……

scripts.text:
[???]
Who's there?!
Who would dare
intrude my territory?
scripts.translation:
[???]
谁在那里？！
谁敢
侵入我的领地？

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
I see...
You must be from
the Rogue guild.
You must be one of the
ones Mr. Smith wasn't
too happy with...
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
我明白了……
你一定来自
流氓公会。
你一定是史密斯先生
不太喜欢的那些人之一……

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
He threw a fit and you brought him all the items he asked for, didn't you? Well, I can see that you're still pretty naive. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
他大发雷霆，而你把他要求的所有物品都带来了，不是吗？嗯，我看你还相当天真。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
I suppose he suckered you into gathering those items, and then passed you on to me. Sad, really.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
我想他骗你去收集那些物品，然后把你交给了我。真可悲。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Well, since you were tortured by him, I'll try to be especially generous to you. My test for you will be simple, so simple.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
好吧，既然你被他折磨了，我会尽量对你特别慷慨。我对你的测试将很简单，非常简单。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
All you have to do is go through an underground tunnel, and walk all the way back to the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
你所要做的就是穿过地下隧道，一路走回流氓公会。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
There is one thing I should tell you, though. You might want to be careful inside, alright?
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
有一件事我应该告诉你。你可能想在里面小心点，好吗？

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
A bunch of pricks have been throwing Dead Branches and casting Hocus Pocus all over the place...
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
一群混蛋一直在到处扔枯树枝和施展随机魔法……

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Well...
Just make it back to the Rogue Guild alive. That's all you have to do!
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
好吧……
只要活着回到流氓公会。这就是你要做的全部！

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Oh right. This is really important. You need a password to enter the tunnel. To unlock the door, the four number combination is ^0000FF3019^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
哦对了。这真的很重要。你需要密码才能进入隧道。要打开门，四位数字组合是^0000FF3019^000000。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Huh...?
What the hell
are you doing here.
Scram, why don't you?
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
哈……？
你他妈
在这里做什么。
滚开，怎么样？

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe door is locked. You'll need to enter the four number combination to open it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF门锁着。你需要输入四位数字组合才能打开它。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt didn't work. Please re-enter the four number combination.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF没用。请重新输入四位数字组合。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFPlease enter a combination of four numbers.^000000

[HermanthornJr.]
Well...
Didn't I tell you
that I changed the
password? *Wink Wink*
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
好吧……
我没告诉你
我改了
密码吗？*眨眼眨眼*

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Oh, you must be
from the Rogue Guild...
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
哦，你一定
来自流氓公会……

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
My name is
Aragham Junior,
Rogue of the Desert.
Are you ready to learn
how to be a Rogue?
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
我的名字是
小阿拉甘，
沙漠流氓。
你准备好学习
如何成为流氓了吗？

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
See, as a Rogue, our motto is, '^0000FFAvoid the strong! Be malicious to the weak!^000000' That rule especially goes true for monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
看，作为流氓，我们的座右铭是，‘^0000FF避开强者！欺侮弱者！^000000’这条规则尤其适用于魔物。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Avoid the strong!
Be malicious to the weak!
It's a simple rule...
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
避开强者！
欺侮弱者！
这是一条简单的规则……

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Now, remember it as you go through ^0000FFthe Underground Tunnel^000000. Try to walk all the way to the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
现在，记住它，当你穿过^0000FF地下隧道^000000时。试着一直走到流氓公会。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
There will be a few monsters, but don't worry. I know you're strong. Alright, are you ready to go or what?
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
会有一些魔物，但别担心。我知道你很强大。好吧，你准备好出发了吗？

[小 阿拉甘]
好吧……
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Fine, fine.
Take your time
and come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
好吧，好吧。
慢慢来，
当你准备好时
再回来。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Oh, you're back.
I think you'll do well this time. Another motto Rogues have is '^0000FFFailure teaches success^000000.' Well, then again...
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
哦，你回来了。
我想你这次会做得很好。流氓的另一个座右铭是‘^0000FF失败乃成功之母^000000。’嗯，再说……

[小 阿拉甘]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Fine, fine.
Take your time
and come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
好吧，好吧。
慢慢来，
当你准备好时
再回来。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Huh...?
Who are you?!
You're not from
the Rogue Guild!!
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
哈……？
你是谁？！
你不是来自
流氓公会！！

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
You've come here to kill me, haven't you? N-no! I'm can't die yet! Get lost! Otherwise, I'll kill you first!
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
你是来这里杀我的，对吧？不-不！我还不能死！滚开！否则，我会先杀了你！

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Hey...
what brings
you back here?
Why don't you
take a rest
before you leave?
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
嘿……
什么风把你
吹回来了？
在你离开之前
为什么不休息一下？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Huh...
From the
Rogue guild, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
哈……
来自
流氓公会，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
I'm Hollgrehenn Junior. I tend to a lot of our underground business. So are you ready to take on my test?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
我是小霍尔格雷恩。我负责我们的许多地下业务。那么你准备好接受我的测试了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
We Rogues share this motto: ^0000FFAvoid the strong! Be malicious to the weak!^000000 This rule applies to any threat, especially monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
我们流氓分享这个座右铭：^0000FF避开强者！欺侮弱者！^000000这条规则适用于任何威胁，尤其是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
It's easy to remember.
Just don't forget to put it into practice. You got it?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
很容易记住。
只是不要忘记付诸实践。你明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
For my test, you'll go through the ^0000FFUnderground Tunnel^000000. Follow it all the way back to the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
对于我的测试，你将穿过^0000FF地下隧道^000000。沿着它一直回到流氓公会。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
There are some monsters there, but that'll be part of your training. Now, are you ready to go or not?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
那里有一些魔物，但那将成为你训练的一部分。现在，你准备好出发了吗？

[小 霍尔格雷恩]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Take your time.
Come back here
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
慢慢来。
当你准备好时
回到这里。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Huh.
You failed.
Gonna try again?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
哈。
你失败了。
要再试一次吗？

[小 霍尔格雷恩]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Take your time.
Come back here
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
慢慢来。
当你准备好时
回到这里。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Huh...?
You're not from
the Rogue Guild...
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
哈……？
你不是来自
流氓公会……

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
You better get out
of here right now
if you know what's
good for you...
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
如果你知道什么
对你好，就马上
离开这里……

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Now...
Beat it before
I change my mind
about killing you.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
现在……
在我改变
杀你的主意之前
滚蛋。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Hey...
Come to visit?
We Rogues gotta
stick together, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
嘿……
来参观？
我们流氓必须
团结一心，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
You're from
the Rogue guild?
If you wanna learn
about becoming a Rogue,
then shut up and stay put.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
你来自
流氓公会？
如果你想了解
如何成为流氓，
那就闭嘴并待着不动。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
^0000FFAvoid the strong! Be malicious to the weak!^000000 That's our motto for battling monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
^0000FF避开强者！欺侮弱者！^000000那是我们与魔物战斗的座右铭。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Show no mercy when you fight weaker monsters, and try to keep away from stronger monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
与较弱的魔物战斗时不要留情，并尽量远离较强的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Now, I want you to walk all the way to the Rogue Guild through this ^0000FFUnderground Tunnel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
现在，我希望你通过这个^0000FF地下隧道^000000一直走到流氓公会。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
There are monsters there, but if you avoid the strong and be malicious to the weak, you'll be fine.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
那里有魔物，但如果你避开强者并欺侮弱者，你就没事。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
I hope you do
not fail this test
You can only become
a Rogue if you pass...
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
我希望你不要
通过这次测试
失败
只有通过……你才能成为流氓

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
I don't have time
to fool around with
you. Hurry up, get
ready, then take
the test.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
我没有时间
和你胡闹。快点，
准备好，然后
参加测试。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
You failed...?
I guess that's life.
Are you gonna try
again or what?
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
你失败了……？
我想这就是生活。
你要再试一次
还是什么？

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Remember, I'm doing
you a favor here...
Now, don't come back
until you're a Rogue.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
记住，我在这里
帮你忙……
现在，在你成为流氓之前
不要回来。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
I don't have time
to fool around with
you. Hurry up, get
ready, then take
the test.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
我没有时间
和你胡闹。快点，
准备好，然后
参加测试。

scripts.text:
Huh...?
Who are you?!
You're not from
the Rogue Guild!!
scripts.translation:
哈……？
你是谁？！
你不是来自
流氓公会！！

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
You've come here to kill me?! I won't let you!! Come on, give me your best shot! You can't fight if I rip out your eyes!
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
你是来这里杀我的？！我不会让你得逞！！来吧，使出你的全力！如果我挖出你的眼睛，你就不能战斗了！

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Hey, how's it goin'?
Take it easy, and just
relax before you leave.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
嘿，过得怎么样？
放轻松，在离开之前
放松一下。

scripts.text:
^F08080Tah dah~
Monsters for the
Rogue Job Change
have been reset^000000.
scripts.translation:
^F08080哒哒~
流氓转职的
魔物已重置^000000。
